notes.title: Amir Chapter 1 is here!
notes.content:
Amir's first chapter is here! Find out more about what this slinky succubus is hiding.

In addition:
[list]
[*]     The chapter selection menu is now grayed out by default and will unlock once you have chosen your MC's name/pronouns/body type in order to prevent missing MC data from crashing the game.
If the chapter menu is grayed out for you and you have existing save data, go into options from the main menu and set your name/pronouns/body.  This will ensure that the game remembers this information this time and should unlock the menu with all your checkpoints intact.  You should only have to do this one time to straighten everything out.
[*]     Added advanced accessibility controls including an additional sans font toggle, text scaling slider, vertical space scaling slider, and easy reset default buttons.  This is still being worked on to refine styling across as much font/sizing as possible-  there are a couple screens where the text scale of Open Dyslexic still runs into a little trouble.
[*]     Typographical/Text Styling adjustments
[*]     New sfx
[*]     New audio tracks
[/list]

And more! Check the Updates pinned thread for a changelist.

notes.title: Troubleshooting Steamdeck Launch
notes.content:
[b]If you're having trouble running TCM on Steamdeck, try these steps:[/b]

 [list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VM0a3c3.png[/img]
[*]  From the game page in your Library, click on the Settings cog
[*]     Choose Properties

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p8cnHyM.png[/img]
[*]     From the left hand list of options, choose Compatibility
[*]     Make sure "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool is checked
[*]     Choose "Steam Linux Runtime 1.0 (scout)"
[*]     Launch game.
[/list]
